questions.question: Comment on how the colonial and commercial ventures of England set stage for the colonial expansion of England in the future.
questions.solution_html:

  • ambition, military conquest and maritime dominance - Rise of middle class played a
  • significant role in the growth of Britain as an imperial power - top strata of middle class
  • did overseas trading leading to the establishment of British colonies in different parts of
  • the world like in the Americas, Africa, Asia and Pacific - Expansion of transatlantic slave
  • trade - transported millions of enslaved Africans to Caribbean and American plantations
  • Colonies like Jamaica, Barbados and Antigua - strong economic sources of Britain due
  • to sugar production - British East India Company changed its motives from trade to
  • establishing territorial power in India (after Battle of Plassey and Battle of Buxar) -
  • Explorers like James Cook - claimed parts of Australia and New Zealand - Britain’s
  • maritime strength significantly contributed to the emergence of Britain as a major
  • imperial power.
questions.final_answer: imperial power.
